package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"sync"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_resource_pooling_buffer_pool_without_max_capacity: Layer: Resource pooling. Flag buffer pools that return arbitrarily large buffers and retain memory after spikes.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

var bufPool = sync.Pool{
	New: func() interface{} {
		return new(bytes.Buffer)
	},
}

func RenderTemplate(data map[string]string) string {
	buf := bufPool.Get().(*bytes.Buffer)
	defer bufPool.Put(buf)
	buf.Reset()
	for k, v := range data {
		buf.WriteString(k)
		buf.WriteString("=")
		buf.WriteString(v)
		buf.WriteString("\n")
	}
	return buf.String()
}
